description:
Term Insurance is a type of life insurance where, if the insured person passes away during the policy tenure, the nominee receives the sum assured.
If the insured survives till the end of the policy term, no maturity amount is paid.
Term plans offer high life cover at very affordable premiums, making them one of the most important financial protections for your family.

WATCH THE VIDEO FOR MORE DETAILS :)

TOP 5 Term Insurance Plans in 2025  :-
1. LIC New Jeevan Amar
2. Axis Max Life Smart Term Plus
3. ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus
